CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ROLE: You can't change your own role. Ask another host.
CANNOT_REMOVE_SELF: You can't remove yourself. Leave the roll instead.
COVER_CHANGED_CONCURRENTLY: Another host changed the cover at the same time. Please try again.
EVENT_HAS_OPEN_REPORTS: This roll has reports waiting for a decision, so it can't be deleted yet.
EVENT_SUSPENDED: This roll was suspended for breaking our terms, so it can't be changed or joined.
EVENT_UNDER_REVIEW: This roll is on hold while Everglow reviews it. No one can join or add photos until then.
LAST_ORGANIZER: Every roll needs a host. Make someone else host first.
ORGANIZER_BLOCKED_BY_CALLER: You blocked the host of this roll. Unblock them to join.
REMOVED_FROM_EVENT: A host removed you from this roll. Only a host can let you back in.
TARGET_NOT_A_MEMBER: That person isn't on this roll anymore.
